Implementation-only requested scope and execution prohibitions.
Inherited total lifecycle, dispatcher, selector, and source-boundary repairs.
Adjudicated V5 consensus requiring exactly three terminal contract repairs.

system_thesis_interpretation: V6 is a proposal-only serialization repair, not a new experiment. It preserves the V4 development question, geometry, source-derived endpoint supervision, four LoRA fits, held evaluation, exact reducers, resource cap, narrow claim, and V5 lifecycle/capability isolation. Its systems effect is to close the three V5 consensus defects in the controlling bytes: every model-facing action on every device is now behind the same pre-model evidence gate; the review gate names one fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate author-side scientific advocate over identical immutable bytes, with neither role substitutable and the advocate unable to override rejection; and the four-commit barrier now supplies the selector an immutable ordered adapter-binding receipt. The architecture remains a finite development scout. It contains no dreaming scheduler, thinker-to-dream consolidation edge, module-level autonomous credit assignment, whole-organism credit assignment, parenting transition, C11 enforcement, or present scientific result. Source success is used only after frozen source closure to admit exact child-authored final ACT endpoints; the outcome, initial ACT, history, admission, and evaluator decisions do not become training tokens. Held results flow one way to scoring and cannot become later model-call, retry, fitting, selection, or dream evidence.
graph_delta_interpretation: Operationally the unchanged pre-source materializer seals the complete candidate bank and index before any source request. Source calls then pass through an instance-scoped source dispatcher, the outcome harness emits only the public success bit, and the eligibility reducer finalizes admission. The trusted compiler derives target-masked rows from admitted final endpoints, and four instance-scoped fit dispatchers produce separate R0/W+, R0/W-, R1/W+, and R1/W- LoRA-parametric states. Temporary generator state, request transports, and likelihood reads remain ephemeral or immutable results; they are not declarative policy state. The four-commit barrier is the sole bridge from fitted state to evaluation selection: it reads exactly four adapter identities, conditions, COMMITTED states, and hashes and emits one immutable canonical fixed-order receipt. After final admission and barrier closure, the trusted selector reads the sealed index, computes canonical selected IDs, dereferences only those immutable entries after bank-root and entry-hash checks, reads adapter-stage information only through the derived receipt, verifies exact root/condition-to-adapter identity/hash equality, and copies those bytes into every non-OFF selected_execution_call; OFF carries no adapter. Missing, extra, duplicate, aliased, stale, reordered, mismatched, non-committed, or hash-invalid bindings fail closed. The selector holds no adapter contents or execution capability. Each evaluation dispatcher receives and verifies exactly one immutable call envelope and writes exactly one immutable raw result, while direct bank, map, admission, row, lived-history, adapter-state, prior-result, and scorer access stays denied. This closes condition substitution, reseeding, reordering, and feedback paths without expanding any principal's scientific authority.
loop_delta_interpretation: The run is an ordered, fail-closed pipeline rather than an adaptive learning loop. Its five run statuses are total: PLANNED and NOT_RUN cover the pre-source side of the global first-request boundary; TERMINAL_LABELED covers two non-null root labels; STOPPED_UNLABELED covers a post-source terminal stop with at least one null label; and residual RUNNING covers every other post-source nonterminal state, including quiescent gaps between source, compilation, fitting, the four-commit barrier, selection, and evaluation. Global source_started controls run lifecycle, while each root's own first-source receipt independently controls whether that root may ever receive SOURCE_INVALID; a fault in an untouched root stops unlabeled. Source scheduling is frozen before admission can influence fitting, the selected workload and V4 maximum remain fixed, the later manifest must keep the conservative total at or below 3.0 A40-hours, and only a declared infrastructure failure may replay identical request bytes and seed with all attempts preserved. No semantic retry, top-up, redraw, changed dose/rank, replacement root, prior-result seed selection, or result-driven feedback is allowed. There are two distinct human boundaries: a later PASS consensus can be exactly ratified only for bounded source authoring and deterministic CPU/fault tests, while every model/tokenizer/source/fit/adapter invocation on CPU or GPU additionally requires all T01-T07 receipts, one immutable execution manifest, the two required T08 role passes on identical bytes, and separate exact human execution ratification. Ordinary mechanism or parenting scouts remain outside this gateway and are not blocked; C11 remains parked.
claim_delta_interpretation: No current claim is created and the V4/V5 scientific reading is neither broadened nor made headline-eligible. A future two-root MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS may support only the already bounded statement about complementary, target-masked endpoint-policy carriage on correctness-selected seen tool-by-mode keys under held renderings and the named spill/interface gates. It cannot establish outcome-token causality, autonomous credit assignment, reasoning-path learning, unseen-key generalization, arbitrary capacity, retention, writer qualification, parenting, a clean child, population inference, or whole-organism behavior. V6 makes even that future reading eligible only when the inherited evidence, all V6 tests, immutable manifest, fresh independent-review PASS, separate author-side-advocate PASS, and exact human execution ratification are all bound to the same bytes. Passing schema or deterministic tests alone is governance evidence, not scientific evidence.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is the complete Cartesian product of 11 information items and 15 principals: 165 unique cells, with no missing or duplicate pair. Its 116 forbidden, 34 visible, 8 derived_only, and 7 hidden cells preserve the V4/V5 typed-stage split. Visible dispatcher cells are instance-scoped allowlists for one bound source request, one bound fit, or one selected evaluation call; they do not grant category-wide access. Hidden execution capabilities mean the source child, trainer, and generators can be invoked by a separately authorized dispatcher without receiving capability objects. The selector has visible read-only admission and index/selected-entry access, but unselected bank payloads remain unreachable; it has no map, trajectory, training-row, result, or execution-capability access. Crucially, its adapter_stage_state cell is derived_only: the only permitted projection is the immutable canonical four-commit receipt containing exact committed identity/hash bindings. The selector may verify and copy those bindings but may not inspect adapter contents, load adapters, mutate stage state, or obtain a capability. The selected_execution_call is visible only to its producer and the evaluation dispatcher, and prompt/continuation bytes alone are projected as derived_only to generators/readers. Raw results remain one-way inputs to the scorer, preventing evaluator feedback from changing source, compilation, fitting, selection, retry, seed, prompt, or later model execution.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 measures deterministic V4 geometry/workload preservation, phase-minimal immutable dispatch, exact ordered receipt construction, and byte-exact non-OFF adapter copying while keeping OFF adapter-free. T02 measures the complete 11-by-15 product and mutates forbidden ingress, serialization, alias, feedback, selected-only dereference, unselected-entry access, and receipt defects; it directly exercises the advertised information-flow boundary. T03 exhausts the global-versus-root-local first-source combinations and therefore measures whether lifecycle timing can fabricate SOURCE_INVALID. T04 retains the complement, target, mask, order, seed, node, optimizer, and fit-geometry invariants, so it detects scientific writer-geometry drift. T05 retains the exhaustive raw-byte parser and stage-overlay fixtures, so it detects interface or parsing drift. T06 combines every exact binary64/reducer fixture with representative checkpoints across the total five-status partition, directly testing both numeric preservation and residual RUNNING coverage. T07 injects path, capability, retry, dispatcher, selector, receipt, lifecycle, and untouched-root faults and therefore measures fail-closed containment and denial of cross-root or C11 contamination. T08 requires one fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate author-side scientific advocate to inspect identical immutable implementation, manifest, and T01-T07 bytes; both must PASS, an independent rejection controls, extra reviewers are only additive, and exact human execution ratification remains subsequent. Every test is marked required_before model_execution, so the serialized gate now covers model/tokenizer/source/training/adapter calls on CPU as well as GPU. These are specified future tests, not executed evidence in the current collecting-interpretations phase.
assumptions: The verified V4 and V5 exact-scope hashes make their preserved scientific and systems contracts normative wherever V6 says they remain unchanged.
Canonical fixed receipt order is a manifest-bound root-and-condition order and cannot be derived from fit completion, filesystem discovery, map iteration, or selection order.

A visibility cell granting a dispatcher visible access is scoped to that dispatcher's single immutable bound request, fit, or call; a category label does not authorize access to other instances in the same category.

The universal model_execution boundary is read as the explicit broader prose boundary: it includes tokenizer, source-model, trainer, fitted-adapter, benchmark, and other model-facing invocation on any device, including CPU.
